github_user.description: The GitHub username of the actor. Used to exchange credentials for an OAuth token.

protocol.description: Preferred protocol for git clone/push. One of 'https', 'ssh', or 'git'.

github_host.description: The GitHub hostname to default to instead of github.com (e.g. for GitHub Enterprise).

github_token.description: An OAuth token with repo permissions to use for GitHub API requests.
